capabilities: Pick photos taken on the daily note's date from an Immich server
Insert selected photos as resized local copies with captions and Immich backlinks
Configure insert position, embed presets, and a custom metadata template
Detect the date from the note title or a frontmatter field
Verify server connection and API key permissions with a test button
disambiguation: Not a journaling or diary plugin; it only inserts photos from an Immich server into notes based on the note's date.
extras: Not yet released as a Community Plugin; install via BRAT until review passes. API key is stored in plain text in data.json. Docs include a settings reference table and a troubleshooting table for connection errors.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a self-hosted photo library by date and insert images into daily notes, so journaling with personal photos requires manual exporting and resizing.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that inserts photos from your self-hosted Immich server into your daily notes

summary: Photo inserter that pulls photos taken on a daily note's date from a self-hosted Immich server and inserts them resized, captioned, and linked back to Immich.
